shen-er-san.additionalInfo: Hu Wen Zhi The points did not appear in Master Tung's original book. They were first introduced by Hu Wen Zhi. The points are three of Tung's 72 Absolute Needles and three of Tung's 32 Solution Needles. These three points are cornerstones of emergency acupuncture. The posterior ear—particularly the hypotensive groove—is a prime anatomical target for clinical bloodletting. Bleeding the superficial posterior auricular veins here provides a rapid, highly effective response to cardiovascular crises, severe hypertension, and acute vertigo. Point Name Shén — Spirit, soul Ér - Ear Ér [B] - Ear Sän E] — Three
